d: In this video, Firstpost explains how Norway has turned an insult from US President Donald Trump into an unexpected tourism campaign. After Trump made an unflattering remark about the country at a Michigan midterms rally, Norway’s tourism board responded by showcasing some of its most scenic public toilets. The campaign asks a cheeky question: are these the world’s best restrooms? From stunning views to clever marketing, Norway has found a way to turn a political jibe into a publicity opportunity. Trump may have tried to flush Norway’s image, but the country is having the last laugh. Hem…
